data.narrative:
Nimble Robotics is a Series C-stage robotics and manufacturing company currently valued at $1.0B post-money, having raised $221M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable in the robotics sector, including Series B and D stage companies such as Exotec ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), Dexterity ($1.6B), and Hadrian ($1.6B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement to the $1.0B last post-money valuation, implying $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector and adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. Both methods converge on identical results, strengthening their signal.

The triangulated range supports a valuation of $1.4B to $2.0B, with a median of $1.7B. This implies modest appreciation from the current $1.0B valuation. Key uncertainties include the timing and success of customer deployment, competitive positioning relative to the peer set, and the sensitivity of robotics valuations to near-term funding environment shifts. The convergence of two independent methods provides reasonable confidence in the $1.7B midpoint, though valuation upside remains dependent on execution metrics beyond the scope of this comp-based analysis.
